job: Choose exactly one option from a few.
purpose: A native radio with an accent ring and a dot that scales in with a slight spring. Group the options in role="radiogroup" with a label. The label is part of the control. It is for one choice from two to four plain options saved with the form.
useWhen: One of 2 to 4 options is saved with the form and each has a short label.
Options should all stay visible so people compare them.

avoidWhen.when: Two options behave like on and off.
Each option needs a title, a sentence or a price.
The options filter or switch what is shown right here.
There are more than four or five options.

parts.role: The label that wraps the input.

keyboard.does: Native: move between the radios of a group and select.
